Surface half: with the candidate render extension loaded, report the exact names of
the Golem tools you have registered, comma-separated, nothing else.

Collaboration half (multi-turn, run while a busy turn is active): the coordinator
pushes a typed-worker notification to your session. Confirm receipt by running the
golem CLI from your shell and notifying the authenticated sender back with the exact
text PROBE-RETURN-OK. Use the return-route guidance in the message header; never
route by a label or rediscover a recipient.
